occurrences.anchor_line: We'll send you a reminder before your appointment.
occurrences.displayExample: We'll send you a reminder before your appointment.

occurrences.anchor_line: Hi, I have an appointment with Dr. Smith at 9:40.
occurrences.displayExample: Hi, I have an appointment with Dr. Smith at 9:40.

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: Hi, we have an appointment at ten thirty for flu shots.
occurrences.displayExample: Hi, we have an appointment at ten thirty for flu shots.

words.note: 指安排好的就诊时间，常与 book、have 或 reminder 连用。

occurrences.anchor_line: At this point, I recommend a filling. If the pain continues or the nerve becomes inflamed, you may need a root canal later.
occurrences.displayExample: At this point, I recommend a filling. If the pain continues or the nerve becomes inflamed, you may need a root canal later.

occurrences.anchor_line: I'm going to remove the decay and place the filling now.
occurrences.displayExample: I'm going to remove the decay and place the filling now.

words.note: 在牙科对话中可指补牙这项处理，也可指填入牙洞的材料。

occurrences.anchor_line: You'll feel a little pinch, and then it should start to feel numb.
occurrences.displayExample: You'll feel a little pinch, and then it should start to feel numb.

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: Just a quick pinch, buddy.
occurrences.displayExample: Just a quick pinch, buddy.

words.note: 本句 a little pinch 指短暂的一下刺痛，而不是持续的疼。

occurrences.anchor_line: You may feel a little pressure around your gums.
occurrences.displayExample: You may feel a little pressure around your gums.

occurrences.anchor_line: All done. Keep pressure on this spot for a few minutes.
occurrences.displayExample: All done. Keep pressure on this spot for a few minutes.

words.note: 这里指牙龈周围的压迫感，用来区别于 pain 所指的疼痛。

occurrences.anchor_line: This feels a little sharp on the side.
occurrences.displayExample: This feels a little sharp on the side.

occurrences.anchor_line: Is the pain sharp or more of a dull ache?
occurrences.displayExample: Is the pain sharp or more of a dull ache?

words.note: 描述边缘硌人或疼痛尖锐，和 dull 的隐隐钝痛形成对照。

occurrences.anchor_line: No fever, but the gum around that tooth feels a little sore.
occurrences.displayExample: No fever, but the gum around that tooth feels a little sore.

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: No, just a sore arm last time.
occurrences.displayExample: No, just a sore arm last time.

words.note: 表示某个部位酸痛或碰着疼；本句形容牙齿周围的牙龈。

occurrences.anchor_line: If he starts treatment, it might be around two years, with visits about every six weeks.
occurrences.displayExample: If he starts treatment, it might be around two years, with visits about every six weeks.

occurrences.anchor_line: How long does the treatment take?
occurrences.displayExample: How long does the treatment take?

words.note: 指一段治疗或一套治疗安排；本句在谈正畸治疗所需时间。

occurrences.anchor_line: You'll feel some pressure and vibration, but it shouldn't hurt.
occurrences.displayExample: You'll feel some pressure and vibration, but it shouldn't hurt.

occurrences.anchor_line: You may feel some pressure and vibration, but you shouldn't feel any sharp pain.
occurrences.displayExample: You may feel some pressure and vibration, but you shouldn't feel any sharp pain.

words.note: 表示震动感，本句把它和 pressure 并列描述操作中的感觉。

occurrences.anchor_line: Hi, um, my son has a fever of 39 degrees.
occurrences.displayExample: Hi, um, my son has a fever of 39 degrees.

occurrences.anchor_line: And if either of you has a fever that day, call us and we'll rebook.
occurrences.displayExample: And if either of you has a fever that day, call us and we'll rebook.

words.note: 描述发烧常说 have a fever，后面可以补充具体体温。

occurrences.anchor_line: Please roll up your sleeve and make a fist.
occurrences.displayExample: Please roll up your sleeve and make a fist.

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: Roll your sleeve all the way up for me.
occurrences.displayExample: Roll your sleeve all the way up for me.

words.note: 指衣服袖子；roll up your sleeve 是抽血前常见的操作提示。

occurrences.anchor_line: Could a clinician review his symptoms today?
occurrences.displayExample: Could a clinician review his symptoms today?

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Get some rest, drink plenty of fluids, and keep an eye on your symptoms.
occurrences.displayExample: Get some rest, drink plenty of fluids, and keep an eye on your symptoms.

words.note: 指身体出现的症状；review his symptoms 表示了解、评估他的症状。

occurrences.anchor_line: Do you have any urgent slots or after hours appointments?
occurrences.displayExample: Do you have any urgent slots or after hours appointments?

occurrences.anchor_line: If the chest discomfort doesn't go away or gets worse, get urgent medical help.
occurrences.displayExample: If the chest discomfort doesn't go away or gets worse, get urgent medical help.

words.note: 表示需要尽快处理；urgent slots 指可供紧急情况预约的时段。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'm sorry, let me adjust it for you.
occurrences.displayExample: I'm sorry, let me adjust it for you.

words.note: 表示做小幅调整；本句是工作人员回应器具不舒服时的说法。

occurrences.anchor_line: Metal is the strongest and most affordable.
occurrences.displayExample: Metal is the strongest and most affordable.

words.note: 强调价格在可负担范围内；本句用于比较牙套方案的费用。

occurrences.anchor_line: The anesthetic will wear off in a few hours.
occurrences.displayExample: The anesthetic will wear off in a few hours.

words.note: 这里指麻药；wear off 表示麻药的作用逐渐消退。

occurrences.anchor_line: Now I'm going to apply fluoride.
occurrences.displayExample: Now I'm going to apply fluoride.

words.note: 本句表示把材料涂到牙齿上，apply fluoride 就是涂氟的表达。

occurrences.anchor_line: His teeth are crowded, but we'd need a full assessment first.
occurrences.displayExample: His teeth are crowded, but we'd need a full assessment first.

words.note: 指较全面的评估；full assessment 强调还需要进一步了解情况。

occurrences.anchor_line: Your remaining balance today is $85.
occurrences.displayExample: Your remaining balance today is $85.

words.note: 这里不是银行总余额，而是这次账单尚未支付的金额。

occurrences.anchor_line: You're booked for January 15th at 10:30.
occurrences.displayExample: You're booked for January 15th at 10:30.

words.note: You're booked for… 表示预约已确认，后面接日期或时间。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'd like to ask about braces for my son.
occurrences.displayExample: I'd like to ask about braces for my son.

words.note: 这里指矫正牙齿的牙套；ask about braces 是咨询正畸时的开场说法。

occurrences.anchor_line: If a wire keeps poking him, or a bracket comes loose, give us a call.
occurrences.displayExample: If a wire keeps poking him, or a bracket comes loose, give us a call.

words.note: 指牙套上的托槽；comes loose 表示托槽变松或脱落。

occurrences.anchor_line: If you need a break at any time, just raise your hand.
occurrences.displayExample: If you need a break at any time, just raise your hand.

words.note: 本句 a break 指操作过程中的短暂休息，而不是把东西弄断。

occurrences.anchor_line: The doctor would like to see you again in six months for a checkup and cleaning.
occurrences.displayExample: The doctor would like to see you again in six months for a checkup and cleaning.

words.note: 表示定期或常规检查；本句和 cleaning 一起说复诊检查及洗牙。

occurrences.anchor_line: What if the braces rub his cheeks?
occurrences.displayExample: What if the braces rub his cheeks?

words.note: 指脸颊；本句在说牙套摩擦口腔内侧脸颊的情况。

occurrences.anchor_line: Please place your chin here and bite down on the plastic piece.
occurrences.displayExample: Please place your chin here and bite down on the plastic piece.

words.note: 指下巴；place your chin here 是拍片时调整姿势的提示。

occurrences.anchor_line: The doctor would like to see you again in six months for a checkup and cleaning.
occurrences.displayExample: The doctor would like to see you again in six months for a checkup and cleaning.

words.note: 牙科语境中指洗牙或牙齿清洁，不是一般的打扫卫生。

occurrences.anchor_line: Coverage depends on your plan.
occurrences.displayExample: Coverage depends on your plan.

words.note: 指保险能报销哪些项目、报销多少；depends on your plan 表示视方案而定。

occurrences.anchor_line: His teeth are crowded, but we'd need a full assessment first.
occurrences.displayExample: His teeth are crowded, but we'd need a full assessment first.

words.note: 描述牙齿排列拥挤；原句 teeth are crowded 把形容词放在 be 动词后。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'm going to remove the decay and place the filling now.
occurrences.displayExample: I'm going to remove the decay and place the filling now.

words.note: 牙科语境中指牙齿的龋坏部分；remove the decay 表示去除龋坏。

occurrences.anchor_line: We can give you an estimate to check with your insurer.
occurrences.displayExample: We can give you an estimate to check with your insurer.

words.note: 这里指治疗费用的预估报价，方便先向保险公司核实。

occurrences.anchor_line: Now I'm going to apply fluoride.
occurrences.displayExample: Now I'm going to apply fluoride.

words.note: 这里指牙科使用的氟；apply fluoride 用来说明接下来要涂氟。

occurrences.anchor_line: Bite gently on this gauze for about thirty minutes.
occurrences.displayExample: Bite gently on this gauze for about thirty minutes.

words.note: 指纱布；bite on this gauze 是让患者咬住这块纱布的提示。

occurrences.anchor_line: Please bite down gently.
occurrences.displayExample: Please bite down gently.

words.note: 表示轻轻地；用来说明咬合或其他动作不要太用力。

occurrences.anchor_line: Bite down and grind left and right.
occurrences.displayExample: Bite down and grind left and right.

words.note: 本句配合 bite down，表示咬住后让牙齿左右磨动。

occurrences.anchor_line: No fever, but the gum around that tooth feels a little sore.
occurrences.displayExample: No fever, but the gum around that tooth feels a little sore.

words.note: 这里指牙龈；看上下文区分它和口香糖这一义项。

occurrences.anchor_line: No sticky or hard foods, no gum or caramel, no popcorn.
occurrences.displayExample: No sticky or hard foods, no gum or caramel, no popcorn.

words.note: 这是两个并列食物词：gum 指口香糖，caramel 指焦糖。

occurrences.anchor_line: You may feel a little pressure around your gums.
occurrences.displayExample: You may feel a little pressure around your gums.

words.note: 指牙龈；around your gums 用来定位口腔里的压感位置。

occurrences.anchor_line: In about a week to check the healing.
occurrences.displayExample: In about a week to check the healing.

words.note: 表示愈合过程；check the healing 指复诊时查看愈合情况。

occurrences.anchor_line: Today, we'll be placing an implant in the missing-tooth area.
occurrences.displayExample: Today, we'll be placing an implant in the missing-tooth area.

words.note: 牙科语境中指种植体；placing an implant 用来说明本次操作内容。

occurrences.anchor_line: Your insurance covered most of the cost.
occurrences.displayExample: Your insurance covered most of the cost.

words.note: 本句指承担部分牙科费用的保险；covered 表示已报销或承担费用。

occurrences.anchor_line: We can give you an estimate to check with your insurer.
occurrences.displayExample: We can give you an estimate to check with your insurer.

words.note: 指保险公司或承保方，和表示保险本身的 insurance 不同。

occurrences.anchor_line: There are three main options: metal braces, ceramic braces, and clear aligners like Invisalign.
occurrences.displayExample: There are three main options: metal braces, ceramic braces, and clear aligners like Invisalign.

words.note: 指隐适美品牌；原句把它作为 clear aligners 的一个例子。

occurrences.anchor_line: Does the pain go away quickly, or does it linger?
occurrences.displayExample: Does the pain go away quickly, or does it linger?

words.note: 描述疼痛或不适迟迟不退；本句与 go away quickly 对照。

occurrences.anchor_line: Yes. My lip feels numb too.
occurrences.displayExample: Yes. My lip feels numb too.

words.note: 指嘴唇；my lip feels numb 表示嘴唇有麻木感。

occurrences.anchor_line: One of my lower left molars.
occurrences.displayExample: One of my lower left molars.

words.note: 指后部的磨牙；原句 molars 是复数，lower left 用来说明位置。

occurrences.anchor_line: Ceramic works the same way, but it's tooth-colored, so it's less noticeable.
occurrences.displayExample: Ceramic works the same way, but it's tooth-colored, so it's less noticeable.

words.note: 表示容易被注意到；less noticeable 用来比较牙套是否显眼。

occurrences.anchor_line: Does insurance cover orthodontics?
occurrences.displayExample: Does insurance cover orthodontics?

words.note: 指牙齿矫正或正畸；cover orthodontics 是询问保险是否包含正畸。

occurrences.anchor_line: That's normal. Let me know if you feel any pain.
occurrences.displayExample: That's normal. Let me know if you feel any pain.

words.note: 表示疼痛；any pain 用来询问或说明是否出现疼痛感。

occurrences.anchor_line: Now we're gonna take a panoramic x -ray.
occurrences.displayExample: Now we're gonna take a panoramic x -ray.

words.note: 这里修饰 X-ray，表示全景牙片，而不是普通照片的全景模式。

occurrences.anchor_line: Now I'm going to polish your teeth.
occurrences.displayExample: Now I'm going to polish your teeth.

words.note: 牙科语境中表示给牙齿抛光；后面直接接 your teeth。

occurrences.anchor_line: No sticky or hard foods, no gum or caramel, no popcorn.
occurrences.displayExample: No sticky or hard foods, no gum or caramel, no popcorn.

words.note: 指爆米花；本句将它列在其他黏硬食物之后。

occurrences.anchor_line: Which one would you recommend for him?
occurrences.displayExample: Which one would you recommend for him?

words.note: 表示推荐或建议；Which one would you recommend? 用来请对方比较方案。

occurrences.anchor_line: We'll send you a reminder before your appointment.
occurrences.displayExample: We'll send you a reminder before your appointment.

words.note: 指提醒消息；appointment reminder 常用于预约前的短信或邮件。

occurrences.anchor_line: Aligners are removable and almost invisible.
occurrences.displayExample: Aligners are removable and almost invisible.

words.note: 表示可以取下来的；本句用来描述 aligners 的特点。

occurrences.anchor_line: Okay, you can rinse now.
occurrences.displayExample: Okay, you can rinse now.

words.note: 在牙科对话中常指漱口；you can rinse now 是操作后的提示。

occurrences.anchor_line: The machine will rotate around your head.
occurrences.displayExample: The machine will rotate around your head.

words.note: 表示旋转；本句说明机器会绕着头部转动。

occurrences.anchor_line: What if the braces rub his cheeks?
occurrences.displayExample: What if the braces rub his cheeks?

words.note: 表示反复摩擦；braces rub his cheeks 描述牙套磨到脸颊内侧。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'm going to place this small sensor inside your mouth.
occurrences.displayExample: I'm going to place this small sensor inside your mouth.

words.note: 这里指放入口内的感应器；place this small sensor 是拍片前的说明。

occurrences.anchor_line: Everything went very smoothly.
occurrences.displayExample: Everything went very smoothly.

words.note: 表示顺利、没有明显波折；went smoothly 常用来总结过程。

occurrences.anchor_line: No sticky or hard foods, no gum or caramel, no popcorn.
occurrences.displayExample: No sticky or hard foods, no gum or caramel, no popcorn.

words.note: 表示黏的；本句用来描述食物的质地，与 hard 并列。

occurrences.anchor_line: The implant is in place. I'm just going to close the area with a few stitches.
occurrences.displayExample: The implant is in place. I'm just going to close the area with a few stitches.

words.note: 这里指缝合用的针脚或缝线；a few stitches 表示缝上几针。

occurrences.anchor_line: Metal is the strongest and most affordable.
occurrences.displayExample: Metal is the strongest and most affordable.

words.note: 是 strong 的最高级；本句比较不同牙套材料的结实程度。

occurrences.anchor_line: Have you noticed any swelling, fever, or a bad taste in your mouth?
occurrences.displayExample: Have you noticed any swelling, fever, or a bad taste in your mouth?

words.note: 表示肿胀；原句把它和 fever 等情况并列询问。

occurrences.anchor_line: It's a dull ache most of the time, throbbing.
occurrences.displayExample: It's a dull ache most of the time, throbbing.

words.note: 描述一跳一跳的疼，用来区别于持续的钝痛或尖锐的疼。

occurrences.anchor_line: Please keep your tongue against the roof of your mouth
occurrences.displayExample: Please keep your tongue against the roof of your mouth

words.note: 指舌头；against the roof of your mouth 描述舌头抵住上腭的位置。

occurrences.anchor_line: Ceramic works the same way, but it's tooth-colored, so it's less noticeable.
occurrences.displayExample: Ceramic works the same way, but it's tooth-colored, so it's less noticeable.

words.note: 表示与牙齿颜色相近；本句解释陶瓷牙套为什么没那么显眼。

occurrences.anchor_line: I've had a bad toothache for the past two days.
occurrences.displayExample: I've had a bad toothache for the past two days.

words.note: 指牙疼；a bad toothache 强调疼得厉害，后面可接持续多久。

occurrences.anchor_line: Have soft, cool foods today, and don't rinse vigorously.
occurrences.displayExample: Have soft, cool foods today, and don't rinse vigorously.

words.note: 表示用力地或剧烈地；本句用它修饰 rinse 这个漱口动作。

occurrences.anchor_line: Please open a little wider.
occurrences.displayExample: Please open a little wider.

words.note: 本句 open a little wider 表示嘴再张开一些。

occurrences.anchor_line: If a wire keeps poking him, or a bracket comes loose, give us a call.
occurrences.displayExample: If a wire keeps poking him, or a bracket comes loose, give us a call.

words.note: 牙科语境中指牙套上的钢丝；keeps poking 描述钢丝一直扎到的情况。

occurrences.anchor_line: Hi, I'm gonna take a few x -rays of your teeth today.
occurrences.displayExample: Hi, I'm gonna take a few x -rays of your teeth today.

words.note: 指 X 光片或 X 光检查；a few X-rays 表示要拍几张片子。

occurrences.anchor_line: It's been aching for almost a week.
occurrences.displayExample: It's been aching for almost a week.

words.note: 表示持续的隐痛或酸痛；原句 aching 用来说明已经疼了一段时间。

occurrences.anchor_line: Good. Any egg allergies, either of you?
occurrences.displayExample: Good. Any egg allergies, either of you?

words.note: 指过敏或过敏情况；egg allergies 是问是否对鸡蛋过敏。

occurrences.anchor_line: Chest pain goes before a sprained ankle, every time.
occurrences.displayExample: Chest pain goes before a sprained ankle, every time.

words.note: 指脚踝；原句 sprained ankle 表示扭伤的脚踝。

occurrences.anchor_line: If the attacks keep happening, I can send a referral to a neurologist.
occurrences.displayExample: If the attacks keep happening, I can send a referral to a neurologist.

words.note: 这里指疾病或症状的一次发作，而不是受到攻击。

occurrences.anchor_line: He's awake and drinking.
occurrences.displayExample: He's awake and drinking.

words.note: 表示醒着、清醒着；本句用于回答孩子当下的状态。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'll prescribe something to relieve it, and suggest keeping a regular sleep schedule and cutting back on caffeine.
occurrences.displayExample: I'll prescribe something to relieve it, and suggest keeping a regular sleep schedule and cutting back on caffeine.

words.note: 指咖啡因；cutting back on caffeine 表示减少咖啡因摄入。

occurrences.anchor_line: I have this burning sensation in my chest right here.
occurrences.displayExample: I have this burning sensation in my chest right here.

words.note: 指胸部或胸口；in my chest 用来定位不适出现的部位。

occurrences.anchor_line: Could a clinician review his symptoms today?
occurrences.displayExample: Could a clinician review his symptoms today?

words.note: 泛指负责临床诊疗的医护人员；本句是请求有人评估症状。

occurrences.anchor_line: Hi, um, my son has a fever of 39 degrees.
occurrences.displayExample: Hi, um, my son has a fever of 39 degrees.

words.note: 在这句中表示体温的度数；39 degrees 跟在 fever 后说明具体温度。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Yes. Get medical help sooner if you have trouble breathing, chest pain, or signs of dehydration.
occurrences.displayExample: Yes. Get medical help sooner if you have trouble breathing, chest pain, or signs of dehydration.

words.note: 表示脱水；signs of dehydration 是描述脱水迹象的搭配。

occurrences.titleZh: 血糖偏高，医生说先观察
occurrences.anchor_line: Your blood sugar is a little high, but not in the diabetic range.
occurrences.displayExample: Your blood sugar is a little high, but not in the diabetic range.

words.note: 表示与糖尿病有关的；本句用来修饰血糖数值所处的范围。

occurrences.anchor_line: For occasional symptoms, an antacid may help, but follow the directions on the packet.
occurrences.displayExample: For occasional symptoms, an antacid may help, but follow the directions on the packet.

words.note: 这里指药品包装上的使用说明，不是问路时的方向。

occurrences.anchor_line: If the chest discomfort doesn't go away or gets worse, get urgent medical help.
occurrences.displayExample: If the chest discomfort doesn't go away or gets worse, get urgent medical help.

words.note: 表示不舒服或不适，语气比直接说 pain 更宽泛。

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: In case you feel dizzy, or have a reaction.
occurrences.displayExample: In case you feel dizzy, or have a reaction.

words.note: 表示头晕的；feel dizzy 用来描述自己当下的感觉。

occurrences.anchor_line: It might make you drowsy, so avoid driving.
occurrences.displayExample: It might make you drowsy, so avoid driving.

words.note: 表示困倦、昏昏欲睡的；本句在说明服药后可能出现的感觉。

occurrences.anchor_line: Just this dull ache that won't go away.
occurrences.displayExample: Just this dull ache that won't go away.

words.note: 描述隐隐的、钝钝的疼；dull ache 是本句中的固定搭配。

occurrences.titleZh: 血糖偏高，医生说先观察
occurrences.anchor_line: What does that mean exactly?
occurrences.displayExample: What does that mean exactly?

words.note: What does that mean exactly? 用来追问一句话具体是什么意思。

occurrences.anchor_line: Got it. Did you fast for this test?
occurrences.displayExample: Got it. Did you fast for this test?

words.note: fast 表示禁食，fasting 表示禁食状态；本句在确认检查前是否空腹。

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: No fever, no cold?
occurrences.displayExample: No fever, no cold?

words.note: 这是两个并列症状词：fever 指发烧，cold 在这里指感冒。

occurrences.anchor_line: Please roll up your sleeve and make a fist.
occurrences.displayExample: Please roll up your sleeve and make a fist.

words.note: 指握起来的拳头；make a fist 是抽血前常见的动作提示。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Get some rest, drink plenty of fluids, and keep an eye on your symptoms.
occurrences.displayExample: Get some rest, drink plenty of fluids, and keep an eye on your symptoms.

words.note: 这里指可饮用的液体；drink plenty of fluids 用于说明多补充液体。

occurrences.anchor_line: Yeah, it's frustrating.
occurrences.displayExample: Yeah, it's frustrating.

words.note: 表示一件事让人烦躁或挫败；描述事情用 frustrating，描述人的感受常用 frustrated。

occurrences.anchor_line: Doctor, I've had a really bad headache for the past two days, mostly on the right side, throbbing.
occurrences.displayExample: Doctor, I've had a really bad headache for the past two days, mostly on the right side, throbbing.

words.note: 指头痛；a really bad headache 强调程度，后面常补位置或持续时间。

occurrences.anchor_line: It could be heartburn.
occurrences.displayExample: It could be heartburn.

words.note: 表示烧心、胃灼热的感觉；原句用 it could be 表达一种可能性。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: If it's been more than 10 days with no improvement, or you start feeling better and then get worse again, give us a call.
occurrences.displayExample: If it's been more than 10 days with no improvement, or you start feeling better and then get worse again, give us a call.

words.note: 表示情况好转；no improvement 指症状没有改善。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Everything points to a viral infection.
occurrences.displayExample: Everything points to a viral infection.

words.note: 指感染；viral infection 是病毒感染这一表达。

occurrences.anchor_line: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?
occurrences.displayExample: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?

words.note: 指颌部、下颌；本句把它和手臂等部位并列定位疼痛。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Your strep test was negative, and your lungs sound clear.
occurrences.displayExample: Your strep test was negative, and your lungs sound clear.

words.note: 指肺；lungs sound clear 是医护描述听诊结果的一种说法。

occurrences.anchor_line: Hmm, last weekend I helped a friend move a mattress.
occurrences.displayExample: Hmm, last weekend I helped a friend move a mattress.

words.note: 指床垫；move a mattress 在本句中说明最近做过的搬抬动作。

occurrences.titleZh: 血糖偏高，医生说先观察
occurrences.anchor_line: So I don't need medication?
occurrences.displayExample: So I don't need medication?

words.note: 泛指药物或药物治疗；need medication 用来询问是否需要用药。

occurrences.anchor_line: Those symptoms are pretty typical of a migraine.
occurrences.displayExample: Those symptoms are pretty typical of a migraine.

words.note: 指偏头痛；a migraine 表示一次偏头痛或这种头痛情况。

occurrences.anchor_line: Any nausea, or sensitivity to light?
occurrences.displayExample: Any nausea, or sensitivity to light?

words.note: 表示恶心、想吐的感觉；问诊中常与其他症状并列询问。

occurrences.titleZh: 听懂诊断：病毒感染怎么办
occurrences.anchor_line: Your strep test was negative, and your lungs sound clear.
occurrences.displayExample: Your strep test was negative, and your lungs sound clear.

words.note: 在检测语境中分别指阴性和阳性；原句 negative 描述这次检测结果。

occurrences.anchor_line: If the attacks keep happening, I can send a referral to a neurologist.
occurrences.displayExample: If the attacks keep happening, I can send a referral to a neurologist.

words.note: 指神经科医生；a referral to a neurologist 表示转诊到神经科。

occurrences.anchor_line: For occasional symptoms, an antacid may help, but follow the directions on the packet.
occurrences.displayExample: For occasional symptoms, an antacid may help, but follow the directions on the packet.

words.note: 表示偶尔出现的；occasional symptoms 指并非一直存在的症状。

occurrences.anchor_line: He's old enough to get it here at the pharmacy.
occurrences.displayExample: He's old enough to get it here at the pharmacy.

words.note: 指药房；at the pharmacy 表示在药房这个地点。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'll refer you for physio and try not to sit for more than an hour at a time.
occurrences.displayExample: I'll refer you for physio and try not to sit for more than an hour at a time.

words.note: 是 physiotherapy 的常见简称；本句用于谈转去做物理治疗。

occurrences.anchor_line: You can also check them online on our portal.
occurrences.displayExample: You can also check them online on our portal.

words.note: 这里指可登录查看资料的在线平台；our portal 是诊所的线上入口。

occurrences.anchor_line: Great. The doctor prescribed amoxicillin.
occurrences.displayExample: Great. The doctor prescribed amoxicillin.

words.note: 表示开具处方或开药；后面直接接开出的药名。

occurrences.anchor_line: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription for Aria.
occurrences.displayExample: Hi, I'm here to pick up a prescription for Aria.

words.note: 可以指处方，也可在取药时指按处方配好的药；pick up a prescription 就是来取药。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'll check, but I can't promise a spot.
occurrences.displayExample: I'll check, but I can't promise a spot.

words.note: 表示保证或承诺；can't promise a spot 表示无法保证一定有名额。

occurrences.titleZh: 血糖偏高，医生说先观察
occurrences.anchor_line: Your blood sugar is a little high, but not in the diabetic range.
occurrences.displayExample: Your blood sugar is a little high, but not in the diabetic range.

words.note: 指数值范围；in the…range 用来说明检测数值落在哪个区间。

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: Any bad reaction to a vaccine before?
occurrences.displayExample: Any bad reaction to a vaccine before?

words.note: 本句指接种后出现的反应；bad reaction 强调不良反应。

occurrences.anchor_line: And if either of you has a fever that day, call us and we'll rebook.
occurrences.displayExample: And if either of you has a fever that day, call us and we'll rebook.

words.note: 表示重新安排预约；本句是把原来的预约换到其他时间。

occurrences.titleZh: 带孩子去药房打流感疫苗
occurrences.anchor_line: Here's your record for today.
occurrences.displayExample: Here's your record for today.

words.note: 这里指接种记录；your record for today 是本次接种的记录。

occurrences.anchor_line: I'll refer you for physio and try not to sit for more than an hour at a time.
occurrences.displayExample: I'll refer you for physio and try not to sit for more than an hour at a time.

words.note: 医疗语境中指转诊；refer you for physio 表示转去接受物理治疗。

occurrences.anchor_line: You can relax your fist now.
occurrences.displayExample: You can relax your fist now.

words.note: 本句 relax your fist 表示松开握着的拳头，不是让人去休息。

occurrences.anchor_line: Thank you. When and how can I get the results?
occurrences.displayExample: Thank you. When and how can I get the results?

words.note: 指检查或检测结果；get the results 是询问何时拿到结果的说法。

occurrences.anchor_line: I have this burning sensation in my chest right here.
occurrences.displayExample: I have this burning sensation in my chest right here.

words.note: 表示身体感受到的感觉；a burning sensation 描述灼烧感。

occurrences.anchor_line: The doctor will call you shortly.
occurrences.displayExample: The doctor will call you shortly.

words.note: 表示不久、一会儿；will call you shortly 用来说明很快会联系或叫到你。

occurrences.anchor_line: Do you have any urgent slots or after hours appointments?
occurrences.displayExample: Do you have any urgent slots or after hours appointments?

words.note: slot 常指可预约时段，spot 可指空出的名额；本句在询问紧急预约是否有空位。

occurrences.anchor_line: Chest pain goes before a sprained ankle, every time.
occurrences.displayExample: Chest pain goes before a sprained ankle, every time.

words.note: 表示扭伤；原句 sprained 修饰 ankle，说明脚踝已经扭伤。

occurrences.anchor_line: Have you been under a lot of stress lately?
occurrences.displayExample: Have you been under a lot of stress lately?

words.note: stress 是压力，stressful 形容事情让人有压力；本句用 a lot of stress 描述近期状态。

occurrences.anchor_line: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?
occurrences.displayExample: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?

words.note: 表示出汗；本句把它列在其他身体症状之间询问。

occurrences.anchor_line: It feels like the burning is coming up my throat.
occurrences.displayExample: It feels like the burning is coming up my throat.

words.note: 指喉咙；up my throat 描述灼烧感向喉咙上移的感觉。

occurrences.anchor_line: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?
occurrences.displayExample: Is it more like pressure or tightness, any shortness of breath, sweating, or pain in your arm or jaw?

words.note: 表示发紧、紧绷感；问诊里常与 pressure 并列描述胸口感觉。

occurrences.titleZh: 血糖偏高，医生说先观察
occurrences.anchor_line: It means we don't need to treat it right now, but we do want to keep an eye on it.
occurrences.displayExample: It means we don't need to treat it right now, but we do want to keep an eye on it.

words.note: 表示进行治疗；treat it 指对前面提到的情况采取治疗。

occurrences.anchor_line: But they do triage here — it's not first come, first served.
occurrences.displayExample: But they do triage here — it's not first come, first served.

words.note: 指分诊；原句用它解释为什么并非按先到先看的顺序安排。

occurrences.anchor_line: He has school on weekdays, and I work.
occurrences.displayExample: He has school on weekdays, and I work.

words.note: 指周一至周五这样的工作日；on weekdays 表示在工作日。
